profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer at Meta. Tech Lead with over 10 years of experience in API design, System Architecture and Privacy Compliance, while supporting a sizeable engineering org.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Continued to act as Tech Lead for Node API, providing my Architecture and System expertise. Grew the project further (10->30+ engineers), by splitting it into teams of dedicated expertise (API, System, Compiler, Privacy and Language bindings). Partnered with managers to design communication and reporting pipelines needed for a wider decentralized group.

Led regulatory workstreams for Instagram and Meta's backend services, relying on Node as the solution for privacy safe data access, data ingestion and data deletion in those environments. Including but not limited to FTC orders, EU's GDPR, CA's CCPA...

Designed and justified creation of a dedicated team to migrate Node's green-field language bindings' capabilities into an easy to maintain standalone solution. The new solution has been adopted by numerous API providers and its proving to be a step function to resolve the challenge of supporting Meta's Polyglot Infrastructure.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed Node API, a programming language-independent and datastore-independent ORM to retrieve privacy checked data from any backend service inside Meta's polyglot infrastructure. Node's modular architecture is centered on a core C++ runtime which provides a language interface (supporting 5 by 2020: C++, Python, Haskell, Erlang & Rust) and a datastore interface (supporting 7 by 2020). Made possible through development of various green-field capabilities in regard to language bindings (notably coroutine interoperability) and C++ abstractions, under my system expertise.

Created, grew and led a team of engineers (10+) to develop Node API, to streamline its adoption and to support customers across Meta's Family of App (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp) and backend systems (AI Integrity, Ads...). Also supported acquisitions to integrate to Meta's Datacenter environment and to migrate from their original Cache and Database systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned the PHP client for TAO, Meta's graph-oriented Cache and Database distributed service that powers the Social Graph (https://www.micahlerner.com/2021/10/13/tao-facebooks-distributed-data-store-for-the-social-graph.html).

Led the migration of the client to HHVM's coroutine and Hack typechecker upon release, and drove the codebase migration (codemod)

Achieved recognized step function improvements in term of CPU Efficiency (adding up to multiple % of the overall codebase), Developer Experience and Reliability

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Founded with Damien Letellier an innovative website based startup. Providing a central location for fans of eSports to bet on professional gaming tournaments.

company.name: eSport Betting League (Play money betting on electronic sports)

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description: Worked with Pr. John C. Mitchell and Dr. Elie Bursztein on analyzing CAPTCHA efficiency. Lead developer of Decaptcha, the tool designed to assess image, audio and video CAPTCHAS security against cutting-edge imaging and machine learning algorithms. Implemented advanced vision algorithms and used numerous machine learning classifiers. Worked with Dr. Elie Bursztein and Jean-Michel Picod on developing OWADE, a Windows offline forensic tool. Responsible for the pipeline architecture and the integration of various forensic modules. Coordinated the development cycle.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for teaching C, C++ and Java on Unix to first year students at EPITA. Developed and super- vised multiple C++ projects designed to teach students software design and oriented-object programming. Coordinated a team of five teaching assistants responsible for supervising the shell and the compiler projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for designing and implementing in Python a framework to perform regression testing and performance measurement. Re-engineered the development cycle to increase and improve the quality of the appliance software releases. Established the performance and quality metrics used to analyze the improvement of the appliance software between iterations.

educations.schoolName: EPITA, Grande École d'ingénieurs spécialisée dans les technologies avancées

projects.title: Decaptcha: A generic image, audio and video captcha breaker
projects.description:
Presented at the 18th ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security
With Pr. John C. Mitchell and Dr. Elie Bursztein
- Designed the generic architecture of the pipeline for image, audio and video captchas
- Created the user friendly interface for the breaker using WPF (based on the Visual Studio one)
- Implemented most of the modules for the image captcha pipeline, from denoising to classifying the letters
- Broke 13 out of the 15 targeted captchas (Blizzard, Captcha.net, Digg, eBay, Slashdot, Wikipedia. . . )

projects.title: OWADE: A cloud-based forensic tool
projects.description:
Presented at the Black Hat, USA 2011
With Dr. Elie Bursztein and Jean-Michel Picod
- Designed and realized OWADE's core architecture, database and module system
- Created the user interface for the tool using Django
- Implemented many modules including the file extraction and the Firefox password recovery
